pages.title: Aleph-One
pages.text: The next size of infinity after the countable one: the cardinality of omega-one. Whether it equals the size of the real line is independent of the standard axioms. The token is dense and unbearably large for something that fits in a hand.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Measuring omega-one with cardinal shards in the Ordinal Recursor, I found the next infinity after the countable one. Synaptic fluid helped me hold the concept in mind long enough.
Made in $(item)Ordinal Recursor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes II, Inaccessible Cardinal, Transcendent Cache.
